claims.quantifier: For every source under the complete SS contract, its ordered original U/L shield lengths are exactly one of (2,2),(2,3),(3,2).
source_contract: Finite simple original disk G with ordered induced-C5 outer boundary B.
Complete Sigma(G)=933/941 or one common whole-graph D5 image; every original nonboundary edge Sigma-critical; epsilon(G)=2.
Effective original H connected and G full B-touch; exactly two nonadjacent complete degree5 roots r,s, all other effective original vertices complete degree4.
H minus {r,s} has exactly three complete original components: unique unary U and mixed L,S; each one-sided with nonempty actual support; both mixed have positive incidence to each root.

Original U has exactly one root-contact edge rx and no s edge; X=G minus all vertices of U equals the inclusion-minimal rejecting literal-beta 45/54 core M; common root swap names the lowered-degree side r.
All original vertices and edges outside U are retained; original root incidence equations t_r+k_L^r+k_S^r+1=5 and t_s+k_L^s+k_S^s=5.
Actual support of L is long, not contained in endpoints of any boundary edge; actual support of S is exactly one named original boundary vertex; k_S^r+k_S^s>=4.

One original graph with named ordered contacts, one coordinate per shared vertex, all original attachments/supports/ownership, bridges/rotation, one literal color frame, complete relations and all empty/nonempty fibres and full lifts; D5/S4/root swap act on the whole graph and data only.

L actual support long，BASE1(b)給原shield>=2；one-sided shield原邊互斥及總<=5恰列有序(2,2),(2,3),(3,2)，無需S正費。
